purpose: Auditable world-capital parcel research roster, distinguishing previously investigated city areas from the remaining batch.
scope: 193 UN member states and the two UN observer states, separate established or transitional government seats, and clearly labelled associated/disputed/de facto supplementary seats. Overseas dependencies and ordinary subnational capitals excluded.
scopeNotes: Prior checked includes actual city-specific unsuccessful requests; finding a national agency alone does not count.
The existing African-capital roster is carried forward, including its associated seats and separately labelled supplement.
Supplementary city inclusion is geographic research scope and does not express a political-recognition position.

scopeSources.purpose: Holy See and State of Palestine observer states
Amsterdam capital; The Hague seat of government and parliament
Montenegro constitution: Podgorica capital and Cetinje Old Royal Capital
Nusantara planned political-capital transition; existing Jakarta role retained
Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte administrative capital; prior combined Colombo/Kotte investigation
existing city IDs, city researchFile and capital tracker
African national capitals and associated seats with prior/current evidence
five Central Asian national capitals and outcomes
executable city providers and evidence files
reference capital labels, WGS84 points, country codes and regions; tentative for multi-seat or transition cases
cross-check for multiple seats; not used to determine recognition
